job.title: Tenancy Officer / Property Manager (Community Housing)

Location: Adelaide City Fringe
Pay: $58/hour + super
Employment Type: Temporary – Immediate Start

Excellent opportunity to transition from residential property management into community housing.

About the Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced and people-focused Tenancy Officer to join a supportive team and manage a portfolio of residential properties within the community housing sector.

This is a rewarding role where you'll combine tenancy management, customer service, property inspections and stakeholder engagement to help create positive outcomes for tenants and communities.

You'll work closely with tenants, support services, maintenance teams and community organisations to deliver responsive tenancy services and help build safe, sustainable communities.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting to the Team Leader, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of a tenancy portfolio, including:

  • Managing residential tenancies in line with the South Australian Residential Tenancies Act and community housing requirements
  • Coordinating property allocations, tenant sign-ups, transfers and vacant properties
  • Conducting routine, entry and exit inspections
  • Managing rental accounts, rent reviews and payment arrangements
  • Responding to tenancy enquiries and resolving issues with professionalism and empathy
  • Coordinating maintenance requests with contractors and maintenance teams
  • Preparing documentation and attending SACAT matters when required
  • Maintaining accurate tenancy records and reporting
  • Building strong relationships with support providers and community organisations
  • Connecting tenants with appropriate support services
  • Contributing to tenant engagement and community development activities
  • Supporting compliance, workplace safety and continuous improvement initiatives

About You

We're keen to hear from candidates who have:

  • Previous experience in tenancy management, residential property management or housing services
  • Strong knowledge of the South Australian Residential Tenancies Act
  • Excellent communication, customer service and conflict resolution skills
  • Experience working with people from diverse backgrounds, including vulnerable and disadvantaged communities
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • High attention to detail and accurate record-keeping skills
  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team
  • Experience using property management systems and Microsoft Office
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Community housing or social housing experience and a background in residential property management
  • Experience conducting property inspections
  • Experience working within not-for-profit organisations
  • Understanding of the Residential Tenancies Act, tenancy processes and dispute resolution
  • Experience using tenancy management software platforms, ideally Chintaro

What's On Offer?

  • Competitive hourly rate of $58/hour + super
  • Meaningful work that makes a real difference in people's lives
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Varied and rewarding work where no two days are the same
  • Opportunity to contribute to positive housing outcomes across South Australia

Essential Requirements

Before applying, please ensure you meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of proven, recent experience as a Tenancy Officer or in Residential Property Management
  • Current National Police Clearance
  • Valid Working with Children Check
  • Current South Australian Driver's Licence
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Availability to commence immediately
  • Currently living in Adelaide

How to Apply

If you're passionate about supporting successful tenancies and helping people thrive in their communities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your property or housing career.

Please submit your application in Word format.

For a confidential discussion, contact Taryn on 0477 703 020 or email taryn@edgerecruit.com.au.

job.title: Safety Manager
job.description:
Safety Manager

Limestone Coast, South Australia (Tarpeena Region)

Permanent or Contract Opportunity | Relocation Support Available

Are you an experienced Safety Manager who thrives on building safety culture, influencing behaviours, and creating meaningful change on the ground? This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale industrial manufacturing operation and play a critical leadership role in shaping the future of workplace safety. Based in the South East of South Australia, this role is ideal for a hands-on safety professional who enjoys balancing operational engagement with strategic reporting and compliance responsibilities.

The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the Site General Manager, you will be a key member of the site leadership team, partnering closely with operational leaders to drive a proactive, behavioural-based safety culture across a complex manufacturing environment employing approximately 270 people. This is a highly visible role requiring someone who can build credibility across all levels of the business, influence positive safety behaviours, and provide practical coaching and support to leaders and employees alike.

The successful candidate will lead a small safety team and be responsible for ensuring compliance, reporting, risk management, training, investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining a strong presence on the operational floor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive and embed a strong behavioural safety culture across the site.
  • Coach leaders and employees on safe work practices and risk awareness.
  • Lead incident and safety investigations, identifying root causes and corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with WHS legislation, policies, procedures, and company standards.
  • Facilitate risk assessments, safety improvement plans, and critical risk management activities.
  • Manage safety reporting requirements and ensure accurate, timely reporting through safety management systems.
  • Lead and support safety committees, audits, contractor management, and verification activities.
  • Develop and deliver safety training and capability-building initiatives.
  • Maintain safety and environmental documentation and support the development of operational safety procedures.
  • Build strong working relationships across operations, HR, and leadership teams to drive continuous improvement.

About You

To be successful in this position, you will bring:

  • Proven experience in a Safety Manager or senior safety leadership role.
  • Strong capability in behavioural-based safety, culture change, and workforce engagement.
  • Experience working within heavy industrial, manufacturing, processing, construction materials, or similar operational environments.
  • The ability to balance operational presence with reporting, compliance, and administrative responsibilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A Certificate or formal qualification in Occupational Health & Safety.
  • Training and Assessing qualifications highly regarded.
  • Experience with safety management systems and reporting platforms.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, accountability, and conflict resolution skills.

What's on Offer?

  • Senior leadership opportunity with genuine influence across the site.
  • Established team already in place to support the function.
  • Large-scale manufacturing environment with varied and meaningful challenges.
  • Opportunity to make a lasting impact on workforce safety and culture.
  • Flexible consideration for either permanent or contract engagement.
  • Relocation assistance available for the right candidate.
  • Attractive salary package aligned with experience.

Apply Now

This is an exceptional opportunity for a safety professional who enjoys being visible, building relationships, and driving sustainable cultural change rather than simply managing compliance from behind a desk.

All applications and discussions will be treated in the strictest confidence.
